title: Gender Neutral Pronouns: They're Here, Get Used To Them
summary: Tom Scott argues that grammatical gender is a silly concept and that the singular 'they' is an established gender-neutral pronoun. The description carries later corrections and reflections he added in 2019.
why: HN commenters link it as a short, friendly explanation of singular they and grammatical gender in discussions of pronoun usage.

quote.text: Tom Scott has a great video on grammatical gender that is worth a watch
